scenes.headline: How GEPA improves a prompt by reading its failures
scenes.sub: Reflective evolution, a Pareto frontier, and omni's mix of optimizers.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pansy! GEPA improves prompts, code, anything made of text, by reading why it failed.

scenes.text: Instead of squeezing a reward number into the weights, an LLM reads the whole trace and rewrites the prompt in words.
scenes.say: The idea: don't squeeze a reward into the weights. Let a language model read the whole trace, and rewrite the prompt.

items.say: Pick a parent prompt from the Pareto frontier.
Run it, and keep the whole trace: reasoning, tool calls, outputs.
The evaluator returns a score, plus feedback in words.
One reflective call reads it all, diagnoses the failure, and writes a better prompt.
The child joins the frontier if it's the best yet on any task instance.

left.title: Greedy search
items: A specialist's trick is thrown away
left.say: Greedy search keeps the best average, and throws away a prompt that nailed one hard case.

right.title: Pareto frontier
items: Keeps anything best on one instance
right.say: GEPA keeps every candidate that's best somewhere, so specialists survive to be recombined.

scenes.label: fewer rollouts than GRPO at most, while beating it by up to 20%
scenes.note: six tasks, the paper's own harness
scenes.say: The paper reports beating GRPO by up to twenty percent, with up to thirty-five times fewer rollouts.

steps.say: Optimize anything needs just a seed text, and an evaluator that returns a score and feedback.
No single optimizer wins everywhere, so omni explores with three engines in parallel, about five dollars each.
It keeps the best candidate from all three.
Then a fresh optimizer continues from that winner, to break the plateau. Twenty dollars per problem, all in.

scenes.title: Frontier-CS mean score, $20 budget
scenes.note: ten problems, the authors' harness, an LLM judge
scenes.say: At that matched budget, omni beat every engine alone. Ten problems and an LLM judge: promising, not settled.

scenes.text: When the optimizer is itself a language model, words are a denser training signal than a reward number.

recap: Reflect on the trace, rewrite in words
Keep every candidate best on some instance
When one engine stalls, hand its best on
scenes.say: To recap: reflect in words, keep the specialists, and hand a stalled search to another optimizer.
